title: TerraJuke icon and artwork
createdBy: Chia Yuen Kai (BoboMimi), using ChatGPT image generation
concept: Earth as a vinyl record on a turntable, with an orbit ring carrying sound waves: Earth is the record, turning under the needle.

files.terrajuke-art-1200.jpg: Full artwork (Earth-record with tonearm and stylus, space background). Used as the link-preview image. Resampled from the 1254 × 1254 original with macOS sips.
files.terrajuke-touch-180.png: Home-screen icon (apple-touch-icon) from the full artwork.
files.terrajuke-mark-512.png: Simplified flat mark (Earth-disc and orbit ring, transparent background) for small sizes. Cropped to the artwork, centred on a square and stray alpha-1 pixels cleared.
files.terrajuke.png: 128 px version of the flat mark: header and browser tab.

revisions: An earlier draft placed a blue double music note at the centre; it was replaced by a tonearm and stylus because it resembled an existing music-app icon.
meaning: Original AI-generated brand artwork. The Earth shown is illustrative: it is not NASA imagery, a scientific map or a sonification input, and no NASA logo is used.
